mentions.name: unheard.fm
mentions.description: unheard.fm is a music discovery engine where listeners define a "Discovery Model" with explicit constraints — specific genres, release years, track popularity, and more — and the app uses that blueprint to source tracks. It keeps results fresh by excluding "known" tracks (songs saved in the user's library and recent listening history) and relies on the user's custom model rather than a vague, opaque algorithm. It is built with a local-first mentality and a focus on privacy, with no black-box AI "vibe" mixes.
mentions.problem: The author was tired of repeat, sponsored, and "safe" music suggestions from Spotify, which put control in the algorithm rather than the user's hands.
